description:
DUAL 250W MOTORS FOR STRONG PERFORMANCE - Equipped with dual 250W motors to deliver smooth acceleration, reliable power, and stable riding performance. The scooter can handle everyday cruising and climb slopes up to 15° under suitable riding conditions.

72WH BATTERY WITH UP TO 7.75 MILES RANGE - The built-in 72Wh battery supports a maximum riding distance of up to 7.75 miles on a full charge, with an estimated charging time of about 2–3 hours. Actual range may vary depending on rider weight, terrain, speed, temperature, and riding habits.

8.5-INCH OFF-ROAD TIRES - Durable 8.5-inch off-road tires provide enhanced traction and stability on sidewalks, pavement, packed dirt, and other suitable surfaces. The rugged tread design helps deliver a more confident and balanced ride.

COOL LED LIGHTING EFFECTS - Colorful wheel lights and bright side LED lights add visibility and a fun, eye-catching look. The lighting design makes every ride more exciting while helping the scooter stand out indoors or outdoors.

UL2272 CERTIFIED & SELF-BALANCING CONTROL - Designed with self-balancing technology for easier control and improved rider confidence. Charger safety, battery safety, and UL2272 certification provide added peace of mind for everyday use. Suitable for recreational riding and outdoor fun.
